objects.text: {g}THE FIRST WATCH.{/}^{t}KNOCK IF IT IS URGENT. IF IT IS VERY URGENT, COME IN.{/}

objects.who: door|Shut. A tablet hangs on the door: {g}OPEN WHEN THE SIGN IS LIT.{/}^The sign is the fire bowl beside it. It is out. It is the only flame on the whole front of the house that is.
objects.say: The lamp seller's sign burns, and inside a bolt slides back.^He built it to work whether he was awake or not. He is a man who thinks ahead.

objects.text: {g}LAMPS. OIL. WICKS.{/}^{t}NO NAKED FLAMES.{/}| Somebody has thought about that, and added: {t}EXCEPT OURS.{/}

objects.who: door|Barred from inside, by a man who has been robbed before and liked it less each time.^The house of Ilu-Bani, cedar merchant to the Temple. There is no bell. People who call on Ilu-Bani are expected.| The watch have always said his cellar is a good deal nearer their lock-up than he would like.
objects.say: The bar lifts out of its hooks.^The front door of the richest house in Ashkel stands open, and nobody in it minds.

objects.text: {g}ILU-BANI. CEDAR.{/}^{t}BY APPOINTMENT TO THE TEMPLE.{/}| And lower, a good deal smaller: {t}NO CREDIT. NOT EVEN THE TEMPLE.{/}
{g}THE TABLET HOUSE.{/}^{t}READING. WRITING. SITTING STILL.{/}| The third has been underlined, by a hand that was plainly doing none of them.
{g}ILTA.{/}^There was a second name above hers once.| She has never painted over it. She has never painted it in again, either.

The rules of the night watch, on a stone of their own, for men who say they never saw the ones over the door.^{g}IF THE CITY WILL NOT WAKE, GO TO THE FIRST WATCH.{/}| Under it, smaller, in another hand: {t}WAKE THE CAPTAIN FIRST.{/}| Under that, scratched with a spear point: {t}YOU WAKE HIM.{/}
The pell. The watch hits it instead of each other.^It has never once hit back, and it still has the better record.
The archery butt. There are three arrows in it.^There are forty in the wall behind it, and one in the bench.
A tortoise, by the pool.^It was not asleep before. It is not asleep now. Nobody has ever been able to tell, and it has never been in a hurry to say.
Crates of copper pots, stacked against the Coppersmiths' wall.^Not one of them has been hammered in forty nights. The quiet is unnatural.
A fig tree, forty years old, heavy with fruit.^Widow Ilta planted it the week her husband went out for figs. To save him the trip.
The tablet house's notice stone. Today's line, for copying:^{g}THE DILIGENT BOY RISES BEFORE THE SUN.{/}| Somebody has added, lower down and not very straight: {t}the sun has not come up.{/}
A handcart, on its side where its owner lay down.^Past the wall is the Dyers' Quarter, snoring in three colours.

{g}RING FOR THE WATCH.{/}^{t}ONE STROKE: A THIEF. TWO: A FIRE. THREE: THE CAPTAIN IS ON HIS WAY ROUND. LOOK BUSY.{/}| Under it, in another hand: {t}the watch comes to ANY noise. kindly stop testing this.{/}
